notes.title: Achievements!
notes.content:
New update for Neon River featuring:

14 unique new achievements
New background music
Bugs in enemy AI fixed

Have fun and stay safe

notes.title: Combat update
notes.content:
[h2]Combat update[/h2]

Major update focused on combat, balance and variety and featuring:

[h3]Generation changes[/h3]
Goldmines will now spawn more frequently in groups, rocks follow certain patterns etc.

[h3]Enemy rebalance[/h3]
Enemies are now less tanky and more fun to deal with, with many stats changed and AI tweaked.

[h3]Added a boss[/h3]
You may fight him every now and then after going far enough from the riverline.

[h3]Other changes[/h3]
Sounds, initial player stats and more...

Have fun and stay safe

notes.title: Update and bugfix
notes.content:
Minor update focused on balance. 
Changes in generation, enemy stats etc:

Weapon upgrades spawn more frequently
Some mobs have less hp or more damage
New generation features, such as "golden places"
Bug fixes

Have fun and stay safe.

notes.title: Publishing delay
notes.content:
Hello everyone. 
We regret to inform you that, due to unexpected circumstances and time problems Neon River was finished later than planned and, as a result, may come out later that planned. The delay may be anything between a few hours and a few days, December 31 being the latest. 
We value the support each one of you gave us and are as upset about this unfortunate delay as you are.
Sorry for this possible delay and have a nice New Year
ZavaStudio
